summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests early intrathecal cytarabine and hydrocortisone to treat ICANS, a nervous system side effect of CAR T-cell therapy, in adults with non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Intrathecal cytarabine (100 mg) and hydrocortisone (100 mg) are given when grade 1 or 2 ICANS starts after axicabtagene ciloleucel or brexucabtagene autoleucel, and dexamethasone IV 10 mg and methylprednisolone 1 g daily until adverse events resolve are also listed. The study measures the rate of grade 3 or higher ICANS and how long ICANS lasts, compared with historical experience.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa la administración temprana de citarabina y hidrocortisona intratecales para tratar la ICANS, un efecto secundario del sistema nervioso de la terapia con células CAR T, en adultos con linfoma no Hodgkin. La citarabina intratecal (100 mg) y la hidrocortisona (100 mg) se administran cuando aparece una ICANS de grado 1 o 2 después de axicabtagén ciloleucel o brexucabtagén autoleucel; también se mencionan dexametasona IV de 10 mg y metilprednisolona de 1 g al día hasta que se resuelvan los eventos adversos. El estudio mide la tasa de ICANS de grado 3 o superior y la duración de la ICANS, en comparación con la experiencia histórica.
who_for: Histologically confirmed non-Hodgkin lymphoma of the listed types
Meets institutional criteria for standard CD19 CAR T therapy
Meets the stated organ function limits for blood counts, kidney, liver and clotting
not_for: Active hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection
Needs anti-platelet or anticoagulant drugs that cannot be safely held
Active malignancy in the last 24 months, other than high-grade B-cell lymphoma, with listed exceptions
History of platelet transfusion refractoriness or declining transfusion support
